name: Ball Corporation
verdict: The US Labor Department found that a Ball subsidiary discriminated against 192 Black job applicants at a Georgia plant in 2020-21.
note: Rating note: concern (maintainer decision, 1 Oct 2026, #935): a regulator's own finding of hiring discrimination counts even though Ball Container settled it (METHOD.md). Ball Corporation is listed on the NYSE (ball-corporation-public-listing); no state in the ownership chain. Holds the naming rights to the Nuggets' arena. A previous rating was removed 2026-09-25 because its only claim was an invented ownership record (#279).

why.text: A US Labor Department review found that Ball Container, a subsidiary of Ball Corp., discriminated against 192 Black applicants for production jobs at its plant in Rome, Georgia, in 2020 and 2021. Ball Container agreed to pay $309,000 in back wages and interest.
why.messageLine: The US Labor Department found that Ball's subsidiary discriminated against 192 Black job applicants at a Georgia plant.
